verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing claims "automated receipts" and an AI-powered expense assistant, and separately claims to "automate GL coding by entity globally". The Expenses API also supports receipt match and upload, so both halves of the story, capture and coding, have first-party claims. However, these are one-line marketing statements with no documentation of how receipts are captured, nothing showing capture happens the moment a card is swiped, and no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documented real-time receipt capture triggered at card swipe, detail on how receipts are captured and auto-matched, documented automatic coding of card transactions, independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have receipts automatically captured and coded the moment a card is used, without manual entry

citations.quote: Make expenses a breeze for employees and managers with automated receipts, an AI-powered expense assistant
automate GL coding by entity globally
View and manage card expenses data, receipt match and receipt uploads
